name: @psyb0t/codexbox
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted codexbox (OpenAI Codex CLI) instance over MCP.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running codexbox instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its file-ops + prompt-running tools: run_prompt (invoke Codex on the box), list_files, read_file, write_file, delete_file. codexbox is self-hosted — you run the server yourself (Docker image, OpenAI Codex CLI inside an aicodebox container) and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-codexbox.

CODEXBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your running codexbox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

CODEXBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the codexbox server was started with CODEXBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set.

url.description: Base URL of your running codexbox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token, only if the codexbox server was started with CODEXBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set.
